title: Haiwaan trailer: Akshay Kumar plays a psychopath killer hunting blind Saif Ali Khan in bloody, intense thriller
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Akshay Kumar is taking a much darker turn with Haiwaan , and the trailer gives a clear glimpse of just how sinister his character is. Directed by Priyadarshan, the action thriller reunites Kumar and Saif Ali Khan after 17 years, with the two actors on opposite sides of a dangerous cat-and-mouse game. After the teaser sparked curiosity last week, the trailer now introduces Saif as a visually impaired man who is forced to face a ruthless Akshay, who seems determined to hunt him down.

Adding to this, Haiwaan trailer: Akshay Kumar turns ruthless villain, takes on blind Saif Ali Khan. The trailer sets up a dangerous chase The 2-minute-34-second trailer sets up an eerie mood, with a growing sense of fear spreading across the city as a mysterious killer appears to be targeting people. Saif Ali Khan’s character is shown visibly shaken as the situation around him spirals out of control. Things take a darker turn when the police arrest him, with the trailer showing him as a blind man caught in the middle of the mystery.

Meanwhile, The story takes a tense turn when a blind lift man, who seems to be a single father, witnesses a murder by a dangerous criminal. Believing that the man cannot identify him, the killer assumes he is safe. But Saif's character's sharp hearing, sense of smell and ability to recognise people by their voices help him piece together what happened.

Notably, Akshay Kumar steps into one of his darkest avatars yet, going head to head with Saif Ali Khan, who takes on the challenging role of a blind man. Adding further intrigue to the chase are Boman Irani as a judge and Saiyami Kher as a cop, alongside Shriya Pilgaonkar and Sharib Hashmi in pivotal roles. The trailer leaves you with one question, when they finally come face to face who will emerge victorious?

As per the latest buzz, Akshay Kumar is playing a character with little room for sympathy in Haiwaan. Unlike the morally complicated villains often seen on screen, his character is described as someone who is simply evil. The star has also spoken about his interest in exploring this side of his acting.

In further updates, In conversation with HT City earlier this month, Akshay shared, “As the title goes, I am playing Haiwaan and my character has no grey shades, he’s out and out evil. I always wanted to play a psycho on-screen. With my last four-five films, I have tried to switch between completely different genres: comedy, horror, action, drama. This is my first time playing evil in the truest sense. I like to constantly challenge myself and Haiwaan is that challenge for me.”

On top of that, Priyadarshan , who has worked with Akshay in popular films including Hera Pheri and Bhool Bhulaiyaa, also opened up that the star's look came together in an unexpected way. He added, “His character’s raw look has been designed keeping the same in mind. Talking to us, Akshay says, “As the title goes, I am playing Haiwaan and my character has no grey shades, he’s out and out evil. I always wanted to play a psycho on-screen. With my last four-five films, I have tried to switch between completely different genres: comedy, horror, action, drama. This is my first time playing evil in the truest sense. I like to constantly challenge myself and Haiwaan is that challenge for me.”

Haiwaan is the Hindi remake of Priyadarshan's 2016 Malayalam movie Oppam, which starred Mohanlal in the lead. In this version, Saif plays a visually impaired martial artist who finds himself protecting a young girl while being pursued by a dangerous psychopath, played by Akshay.

title: Gunmaaster G9: Emraan Hashmi swaps Awarapan 2's heartbreak for a bloody battle to protect his love in gripping teaser
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After the success of Awarapan 2 , Emraan Hashmi is showing no signs of slowing down. The star is now gearing up for Gunmaaster G9 , an action-packed romantic entertainer that brings together romance, intense action and music. Directed by Aditya Datt, the movie also stars Genelia Deshmukh, Aparshakti Khurana and debutant Abhishek Singh.

Adding to this, Gunmaaster G9: Emraan Hashmi returns to his intense lover-boy avatar for another bloody battle after Awarapan 2. Gunmaaster G9 teaser The teaser sees Emraan Hashmi once again step into the shoes of a man willing to go to any lengths for the woman he loves, played by Genelia D'Souza. His character's intense devotion comes through in a powerful dialogue: “Mujhe chahe duniya ki sabse buri maut dena, mere jism ke tukde tukde kar dena aur kawwo ko khilwa dena, par Mahadev se itni hi vinti hai ki jab tak mai apn e ishq ki dehleez tak na pahunch jaun, meri sansein mat lena (You may inflict the most gruesome death upon me—tear my body to pieces and feed them to the crows—but I have just one prayer to Mahadev: do not take my breath away until I reach the threshold of my love).”

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram The teaser also gives a glimpse into the movie's larger-than-life characters. Emraan's character comes across as intense and fearless, with a revolver barrel setting the tone for the action-packed story. Aparshakti Khurana, meanwhile, appears to bring a more unpredictable and quirky edge to the movie, adding another layer to the chaos.

Notably, While the Gunmaaster G9 teaser dropped digitally on August 25, followers will also get a chance to catch it on the big screen. The teaser is set to play alongside Yash's much-awaited Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups in theatres, giving audiences an early look at Emraan's next action-packed outing.

As per the latest buzz, Gunmaaster G9 marks the reunion of Emraan Hashmi, director Aditya Datt and composer Himesh Reshammiya nearly two decades after they first worked together. The trio previously collaborated on Aashiq Banaya Aapne and Dil Diya Hai, making their return together a nostalgic one for followers who remember their earlier films.

title: Bhumi Pednekar stops red carpet entry as national anthem plays, wins praise: ‘Salute to you’
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Bhumi Pednekar is currently in a love-hate relationship with social media. The star was trolled during the CJP protest after she called out protesters for using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. She later received love and appreciation after participating in relief work in Assam. Now, the star is once again making headlines for her respectful gesture towards the national anthem at an event.

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar was lauded online for stopping to honour the national anthem. Bhumi stops red carpet for national anthem Bhumi of late attended the Sarvottam Nagrik Samman 2026. When she was making her entry on the red carpet and posing for photographers, she suddenly heard Jana Gana Mana playing in the background. She immediately stopped the paparazzi, stepped down from the stage and stood in attention for the national anthem. Bhumi's gesture won hearts online, with many praising her presence of mind and respect for the national anthem.

Meanwhile, The internet lauded Bhumi for her gesture. A comment read, "No care for fame, no obsession with the camera — Pehle desh!🙏 Where do we get to see such 𝑠𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑘𝑎𝑎𝑟 in Bollywood these days? Salute to Bhumi!" Another comment read, "She deserves appreciation." One more fan lauded Bhumi and wrote, "The way Bhumi Pednekar immediately stopped to stand in respect for the national anthem was truly heartwarming. Respect for the country and the national anthem before fame—salute to such values!" Another comment read, "Respect, Well Done."

Notably, Bhumi was of late subjected to trolling after she called out protesters during the CJP protest for using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Bhumi had shared a video and shared, “Looking at the videos surfacing now, the kind of language being used, and the way the youth of our country are speaking — the youth of our country... this isn't how we talk, man. We are talking about someone who holds the highest office in the land today. Would we ever speak like this to the elders in our own homes? Can we really resort to using abusive language?”
As per the latest buzz, Her remarks sparked a mixed response on social media, with some users supporting her stance while others criticised the star for speaking out on the issue.

In further updates, Bhumi is currently going through a dry spell in terms of box-office hits. Her last few outings, including Mere Husband Ki Biwi, Khel Khel Mein, Bhakshak, The Lady Killer, Thank You for Coming and Afwaah, have underperformed at the ticket-window. This year, she was also seen in the web show Daldal, which received mixed reviews from critics and audiences.

On top of that, Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows. A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today. title: ‘Let panel work’: SC on plea seeking Amit Shah, Delhi Police chief’s role in protest case
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court on Tuesday shared the five-member high-powered enquiry committee (HPEC), headed by its former judge Justice R Subhash Reddy, should be allowed to conduct its independent inquiry into allegations of excessive use of force during the July 20 protest in Delhi, even as petitioners sought its reconstitution and a wider probe into the alleged role of Union home minister Amit Shah and some other senior government and police functionaries.

Adding to this, The court also urged the petitioners to allow the committee to begin its work. (File image) The matter was mentioned before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant by senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan, who sought an early listing of an application filed by the petitioners seeking reconstitution of the committee. The CJI shared the application would be listed.
Meanwhile, “Whosoever will work, they will work under the direct supervision of this court. We have not disposed of the matter and will monitor everything,” shared the CJI.
Notably, The court also urged the petitioners to allow the committee to begin its work and raise any concerns before the court as the inquiry progresses.

As per the latest buzz, “Sometimes, we have to also work under some constraints like availability and other factors. You all are also there to assist the committee and can point out to us as and when there are concerns. Let them work and see how they perform,” added the CJI.

In further updates, Solicitor General Tushar Mehta, appearing for the Delhi Police, opposed the application, describing it as “mischievous” and objecting to the petitioners’ demand for reconstitution of the committee. When Sankaranarayanan shared the petitioners were only seeking listing of the application, Mehta pointed out that it also named judges whom the petitioners wanted on the panel, apart from seeking probe against certain ministers.
On top of that, “We don’t appreciate mentioning names of the judges like this,” the CJI told Sankaranarayanan.
At this point, advocate Prashant Bhushan, appearing for another petitioner, shared there were “some misgivings” among petitioners but stressed that they were pursuing a common cause.

title: ‘Kutte bhonke hazaar’: BPSC official's remark sparks backlash amid student protests in Bihar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

TRE-4 candidates sitting on dharna in support of various demands at Gardanibagh in Patna, Bihar. (Santosh Kumar/HT Photo) Aspirants and opposition leaders criticised Singh and the BJP-led Bihar government after a video of his remarks went widely shared on social media. They accused him of "likening students to dogs".
Adding to this, Rajesh Singh was responding to questions about the demands of protesting candidates, who have opposed the new two-stage format of the teachers' recruitment exams - prelims and mains.

Meanwhile, On the protests, Singh shared, “I want to ask all those who have problems - why do you not move the court? As far as the Commission is concerned, I would like to quote the proverb - haathi chale bazaar, kutte bhonke hazaar .”

Notably, Singh was also heard asking reporters to ignore his use of the proverb, news agency PTI reported. Roughly translated, it means that an elephant continues walking through a marketplace without being affected by a thousand barking dogs.
As per the latest buzz, However, the video was aired by news channels and widely shared on social media.

In further updates, Facing criticism, Singh later issued a brief video statement. “I had merely uttered a proverb, but my words were twisted out of context. Nonetheless, if I have offended anybody, even unwittingly, I express regret,” he shared.

On top of that, Several aspirants targeted Singh over his remarks. They as per reports shared, "The BPSC official's remarks are proof that in the eyes of the authorities, our worth is not more than that of stray dogs".
RJD working president Tejashwi Yadav criticised Singh and demanded that he apologise. He also urged the Samrat Choudhary government to take strict action against the BPSC official.

title: Amitabh Bachchan reveals how he avoids Jaya Bachchan's scolding, says he helps with chores: ‘I take care of cleaning’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The quiz show Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 has often become a medium for Amitabh Bachchan to share glimpses of his personal life. While interacting with contestants, the star frequently shares light-hearted anecdotes about his family and marriage. This time, he opened up about what he does to avoid getting scolded by his wife and veteran star Jaya Bachchan .

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan spoke about Jaya Bachchan on KBC. ‘I will be scolded’ During the latest episode, a contestant asked Amitabh if Jaya Bachchan scolds him when he returns home late. Her question prompted the host to share an endearing glimpse into their family dynamic.

Meanwhile, He shared, “I know what is going to happen, so what I do is, as soon as I wake up, we have all our family members’ names saved in our contacts and have made a group where I send a message saying, ‘Namaskar’ with folded hands. Then I tell them that I have a shoot somewhere and will be late, so they should not wait for me for dinner. I inform all beforehand, and that saves me. But suppose I didn’t tell her (Jaya Bachchan), then I will be scolded and asked, ‘Where were you? You didn’t inform us. Is this the time to come home?’ So, if I am very late, she eats her dinner and goes to sleep herself.”

Notably, Amitabh also opened up that he participates in household chores and takes care of things at home when the staff is unavailable. He shared, “Whether there are four, eight, or 10 staff members, when there is no one at home, I do all the work myself. I take care of the cleaning and everything. I don’t know how to cook, so sometimes we order food from outside, or sometimes I ask Jaya, ‘Deviji, please make something.’ That makes her very excited, and she makes different dishes for me every day and asks how I liked the food.”

As per the latest buzz, Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bachchan were formally introduced on the sets of the movie Guddi in 1971. Jaya was drawn to Amitabh. While Jaya fell for him early, Amitabh grew closer to her during the filming of Ek Nazar in 1972.

In further updates, After the success of their movie Zanjeer in 1973, the couple planned a holiday to London with friends. When Amitabh asked his father, Harivansh Rai Bachchan, for permission, his father as per reports shared that if they wanted to go on a trip together, they would first have to get married. Amitabh agreed, and the couple had a quick, private wedding ceremony on June 3, 1973, before leaving for London the same day.

On top of that, The couple went on to welcome two children, daughter Shweta Bachchan and son Abhishek Bachchan. They have three grandchildren - Navya Naveli Nanda, Agastya Nanda and Aaradhya Bachchan.

title: Salman Khan steps up to help body double Parvez Kazi after heart surgery, ensures medical care: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Salman Khan has once again proved that he stands by the people who have been part of his journey for years. The star of late stepped in to help his longtime body double Parvez Kazi after he fell unwell and underwent minor heart surgery earlier this month. The star made sure Kazi got the right medical care and support while he recovered.

Adding to this, Salman Khan helps ailing body double Parvez Kazi after heart surgery, manager reveals details. What happened to Parvez Kazi? According to a report in India Today, Parvez Kazi fell unwell at home on August 6. While initial reports suggested that he had suffered a heart attack on the sets, his manager Piyush later clarified that the incident did not happen during the shoot. Piyush shared Parvez went to the doctor after feeling unwell and underwent a series of tests. He was then admitted to the hospital, where doctors performed a minor heart surgery.

Meanwhile, Once Salman came to know about Parvez's health scare, he immediately stepped in to help and made sure he received the right treatment. According to Piyush, Salman was “right there with us” and personally ensured that everything related to Parverz's medical care was taken care of. He added, “Salman sir treats Parvez sir, like a younger brother and helped immediately.”
Notably, He is now recovering and doing better. He is also shared to be deeply grateful to Salman for being there for him and making sure he got the help he needed at the right time.

As per the latest buzz, Parvez Kazi’s health scare briefly raised concerns about Salman’s ongoing shoot for his soon-to-release pan-India action movie with Nayanthara , as per reports titled Monster. With him taking time off to recover, there were reports that Salman might have to take on some of the action portions himself. Kazi is now recovering well and is expected to return to the sets after a few days of rest. The team has also made some changes to the stunt schedule and is taking extra precautions to ensure his safety when he resumes work.

In further updates, Directed by Vamshi Paidipally and produced by Dil Raju, Monster marks Salman’s first movie with the producer. The movie is currently being shot in Mumbai and has several large-scale action sequences lined up. For the shoot, the makers have as per reports recreated an Afghan village at Prime Focus Studio in Movie City. A Korean action team is also working on the movie’s stunt sequences. Monster is expected to hit theatres on Eid 2027.

On top of that, Parvez Kazi has been Salman Khan’s body double for several years now. He has worked for the star on many projects including Prem Ratan Dhan Payo, Sultan, Tiger Zinda Hai, Race 3, Bharat, Dabangg 3 and Radhe: Your Most Wanted Bhai.

Meanwhile, Salman Khan’s war drama Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace is also awaiting a rollout update. The movie, earlier revealed as Battle of Galwan, has as per reports been delayed amid concerns from the Ministry of Defence over certain portions of the story.

title: Awarapan 2 box office collection day 11: Emraan Hashmi's sequel drops 69% on 2nd Monday; inches towards ₹140 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings day 11: Awarapan 2 is proving that its ticket-window run is far from slowing down. After a strong second weekend, the Emraan Hashmi -led sequel faced its second Monday with a major drop in audience turnout. However, despite the weekday slowdown, the movie managed to stay steady and continued to attract audiences across cinemas. The movie arrived in theatres on August 14 alongside Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 and it has left the latter behind, giving it a tough competition.

Adding to this, Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings day 11: Movie faces nearly 69% second Monday drop. Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Awarapan 2 collected ₹ 2.75 crore rupees net in India on Day 11, August 24, taking its total India net collection to ₹ 139 crore rupees. The movie recorded around 10% overall occupancy across 11,344 shows on its second Monday. The movie saw a 68.6% drop on its second Monday, collecting ₹ 2.75 crore rupees net compared to ₹ 8.75 crore rupees net on Sunday.

Meanwhile, Awarapan 2 opened strongly at the ticket-window with ₹ 22 crore rupees net on Day 1. The Independence Day holiday gave the movie an even bigger push on Day 2, when it recorded a 53.4% jump and collected ₹ 33.75 crore rupees net, its highest single-day collection so far. It followed this up with ₹ 26 crore rupees net on Day 3, taking its opening weekend total to ₹ 81.75 crore rupees. The movie crossed ₹ 100 crore rupees in its first week and ended the opening week with ₹ 113.50 crore rupees net in India.

Notably, The next big milestone for Awarapan 2 is the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark in India, while its worldwide run is even closer to another major achievement. With ₹ 196.55 crore rupees already in the bag globally, the movie needs just ₹ 3.45 crore rupees more to enter the ₹ 200 crore rupees club. If it gets there, this movie will become Emraan Hashmi's first solo movie to cross ₹ 200 crore rupees worldwide.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Nitin Kakkar and produced by Vishesh Bhatt, Awarapan 2 brings Emraan Hashmi back as Shivam Pandit. The movie also features Disha Patani and Shabana Azmi in key roles, with Puran Gabbi, Anirudh Rawal, Surendar Vicky, Vijayant Kohli and Atul Kumar rounding out the cast.

In further updates, With the movie excelling in theatres, is Awarapan 3 in the works? Writer Bilal Siddiqui of late spoke to Hindustan Times and shared, “As for part three, Vishesh (Bhatt, the movie’s producer) and I have not had time to speak beyond just a few messages after the movie came out. I am yet to hear from him what his plans are. I hope he thinks of it soon, of taking it forward soon, and then we'll see what it is. I'm very excited.”

title: July 20 CJP protest: No separate probe into claims of sexual assault, says SC
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court on Monday clarified that there was no need to initiate separate suo motu proceedings to examine allegations of sexual assault against women protesters during the July 20 student protests in the national capital, as the issue has already been referred to and prioritised by a five-member committee headed by its former judge R Subhash Reddy.

Adding to this, (Getty Images/iStockphoto) A bench, comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana shared that the high-powered enquiry committee (HPEC), constituted last week to conduct an independent inquiry into allegations of violence during the protests, had specifically been directed to examine complaints of targeted violence, harassment, molestation and secondary victimisation of women protesters on priority.
Meanwhile, The clarification came after senior advocate Shobha Gupta urged the bench to take suo motu cognisance of alleged sexual assault of women protesters during the protests held on July 20.

Notably, Gupta submitted that there were widely reported allegations of women being molested and sexually assaulted by police personnel and sought a separate mechanism for investigating the complaints.
As per the latest buzz, The bench, however, pointed to its August 18 order constituting the HPEC and shared the issue had already been specifically entrusted to the committee.
In further updates, The CJI shared that the committee had been asked to examine the allegations on a priority basis and submit an interim report at the earliest.

On top of that, Responding, the bench pointed out that the committee chairperson, former Supreme Court judge R Subhash Reddy, had been empowered to appoint nodal officers, following which the procedure for submitting complaints would be notified.

The HPEC, headed by Justice (retired) Reddy, was constituted by the Supreme Court to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into competing allegations arising from the July 20 student protest -- petitions alleging excessive force by police as well as pleas concerning violence against police personnel and legality of the protest.

title: Taapsee Pannu’s Gandhari lands in copyright controversy as Kanika Dhillon’s production house denies claims
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Assi earlier this year, Taapsee Pannu is returning with Netflix thriller Gandhari . After the announcement, the soon-to-release movie has run into a copyright row just days before its September 3 rollout. Writer Kalyan Bandi claims the movie is similar to a story he wrote and registered back in 2019. The makers, however, have denied the allegation, stating that the movie is an original story written by Kanika Dhillon .

Adding to this, Gandhari copyright row: Writer seeks credit, claims Taapsee Pannu’s Netflix movie resembles his 2019 story. What Kalyan Bandi claims According to a report in India Today, Kalyan Bandi, an IIT Madras alumnus who works as an Inspector with the Central GST and Customs department, claims he wrote a story titled Gandhari in 2019. He says the story centred on a mother who transforms into a fierce, almost goddess-like figure while trying to save her child from a child-trafficking racket.

Meanwhile, Kalyan claims he pitched the story to Monika Shergill in 2019, when she was associated with Voot and is now a Vice President at Netflix. He says he first reached out to her on LinkedIn and later shared an eight-page story along with a two-page synopsis. According to him, while the material was acknowledged, he was eventually told that the concept did not fit the company’s commissioning slate at the time.

Notably, He says he subsequently registered the story with the Screenwriters Association and continued developing it. In 2023, Kalyan approached Baweja Studios, where discussions around the project allegedly continued for several months. He also says he submitted the concept to JioHotstar.

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Why the Netflix announcement raised questions Kalyan shared the row began after Netflix revealed Gandhari in 2025. The title caught his attention, and he claimed he then started comparing the soon-to-release movie with the story he had written several years earlier. He shared the similarities, particularly the title, made him question whether his concept had been used. Speaking about the title, he shared, "Only I can connect the title to the concept because it was my creativity. How can it be credited to Kanika Dhillon?"

In further updates, He also claimed that the announcement had an impact on the conversations he was having with production houses and caused him both professional and financial setbacks. In September 2025, he sent a legal notice seeking around ₹ 40 lakh in compensation, along with credit for his work. But according to him, getting money was never really the point. He added, " I don't even want money. Just say thank you and acknowledge that it was my idea. I'll be very happy if they can prove to me that this is not my story.”

On top of that, He added that there was no response to his legal notice and the matter never went to court. He shared taking the case forward would have meant spending a considerable amount of money on a lengthy legal battle, something he could not afford as a government employee. He eventually decided not to pursue the matter further.

Kanika Dhillon’s production house, Kathha Pictures, has dismissed Bandi’s allegations, calling them baseless. The makers have reiterated that Gandhari is an original story and urged people not to treat the claims as fact.

Every episode is designed around meaningful themes including resilience, communication, empathy, confidence and curiosity, wrapped in playful adventures that children love.

title: Don't Be Shy: When and where to watch Alia Bhatt's next film as a producer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Don't Be Shy : The rollout date of Alia Bhatt 's next movie as a producer has been revealed! Created under Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt's Eternal Sunshine Productions, a young adult romantic comedy movie 'Don't Be Shy' is all set to arrive directly on OTT next month.

Adding to this, Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the young-adult rom-com is headlined by four fresh faces--Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora, and Piyush Khati. The movie also stars Kunaal Roy Kapur, Anurag Basu, Neha Dhupia, and Anju Alva Naik in pivotal roles.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by αlia bhatt 💛 (@aliaabhatt)

Notably, In a joint statement, Alia and Shaheen shared, "Don't Be Shy has been extremely special to us from the very beginning, and we couldn't be prouder to see it come to life. It captures something so honest about being young--the friendships that shape you, the first loves that change you, the heartbreaks that stay with you, and the process of gradually figuring out who you are. What excites us most is this brilliant young cast; their energy, vulnerability, and chemistry are magnetic, and they bring such life and honesty to these characters. We can't wait for audiences in India and around the world to meet Shy and get swept into her wonderful, chaotic world."

As per the latest buzz, "Don't Be Shy is one of our most cherished films, and we're thrilled to finally announce its global streaming premiere," shared Nikhil Madhok, Director and Head of Originals, Prime Video (SVOD) and Amazon MGM Studios India. "This movie introduces four extraordinary new actors--Aarushi, Ansh, Bianca, and Piyush--who bring an incredible freshness and authenticity to their roles. Led by Sreeti Mukerji and shaped by the creative vision of Alia and Shaheen Bhatt , Don't Be Shy is a joyful, heartfelt celebration of friendship, love, and the beautifully messy journey of growing up. We can't wait for audiences to immerse themselves in Shy's world."

title: Shantanu Maheshwari inspires young creators at Arena Animation’s Perspectives 2026 in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Celebrating 30 years of creative excellence, this year's edition was built around the theme of inspiring the next generation of creative professionals by connecting them with real-world industry perspectives, emerging artificial intelligence (AI) powered creative workflows, emerging technologies and career opportunities within the rapidly evolving AVGC-XR (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics and Extended Reality) sector.

Adding to this, The event featured distinguished personalities including Dr. Amit Behl, acclaimed star and television personality, Mr. Shantanu Maheshwari, a versatile star, dancer and performer, Star Aditya Deshmukh, a popular face across Marathi and Hindi entertainment, Mr. Vaibhav More, Director, Designer & Animator who delivered a special session on AI in Animation & VFX, Mr. Vineeth S, Country Manager – Media & Entertainment, Ark Infosolutions, along with Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited and Mr. Shajan Samuel, Sr. Vice President & National Sales Head- (Arena Animation), Aptech Limited.

Meanwhile, The day-long event blended industry learning with immersive student experiences through keynote sessions, AI demonstrations, star interactions and talent showcases, reinforcing Arena Animation's commitment to nurturing industry-ready creative professionals.

Notably, Students gained first-hand insights into the evolving creative economy, the growing influence of AI in content creation, emerging industry skill requirements and career opportunities across animation, VFX, gaming, digital design and filmmaking. The star interactions further inspired participants through personal stories of perseverance, career evolution and continuous learning.

As per the latest buzz, Media & Entertainment Skills Council (MESC) collaborated as the Industry Partner and Huion as the Technology Partner for Perspectives 2026. These collaborations underscore Arena Animation's continued focus on building stronger industry-academia linkages, enhancing experiential learning and ensuring students gain exposure to evolving technologies, industry standards and career opportunities shaping India's rapidly growing AVGC-XR ecosystem.

In further updates, Beyond industry interactions, Perspectives 2026 transformed into a vibrant student festival featuring Arena’s Got Talent, Cosplay Ramp Walk, interactive engagement activities, AI showcases and the popular Khau Gully Food Zone, providing students with multiple platforms to celebrate creativity, collaboration and self-expression.

On top of that, The event also highlighted Arena Animation's strategic focus on strengthening industry-academia collaboration, integrating emerging technologies into learning and encouraging original intellectual property creation through initiatives such as Arena Animation Originals. These initiatives reflect the institute's vision of developing globally competitive creative professionals equipped with future-ready skills.

Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited, shared, "As Arena Animation celebrates three decades of shaping creative talent, Perspectives has evolved beyond an industry interaction into a platform where inspiration meets opportunity. The creative economy is witnessing rapid transformation with AI, immersive technologies and digital storytelling redefining how content is created. Through Perspectives 2026, we wanted our students to experience these changes first-hand by learning directly from industry leaders, technology experts and creative professionals who are shaping the future. Equally important was giving our students a stage to showcase their own creativity, confidence and passion. At Arena Animation, our endeavour is to create professionals who are not only technically proficient but also innovative, adaptable and globally employable."

title: Kangana Ranaut slams Taapsee Pannu, Rakhi Sawant, Sonu Sood: ‘Mere saman 1% bhi life mein success nahi kama paye ho’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has issued a clarification that she will not stand criticism from a bunch of names in Bollywood who have not achieved any success in their respective careers. The star was seen in conversation with the paparazzi on Monday, as she hit back at several celebrities who have made comments on her in the past few months.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut hit back at several celebrities who have commented on her. (ANI Photo/Rahul Singh) (Rahul Singh) What Kangana shared Kangana shared, “I see such people every day, whether it is Ashutosh Rana, who says that I bark like a dog; or Sonu Sood, who says that I should learn how to behave. People like Rakhi Sawant, who make all kinds of vulgar comments about my character; and Taapsee Pannu, who keep insulting my parents, my upbringing and my background.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ankur chadha (@bollywoodpapking)

Notably, She went on to add, “I have only one message for these people. Agar mere saman 1% bhi life mein success nahi kama paaye ho toh main aap ka koi bhi gyaan nahi sunungi. Sab fail, bilkul unwanted log jo hai mujhe jab dekho chaar gaaliyan dete rahte hai (If you haven't achieved even 1% of my success then I am not interested in hearing your opinions on me. All failed, unwanted people abusing me all the time). They just want to latch on to the media, but first become someone like me. Can you? I am not here to listen to you. These hungry people cannot comment on me and I will not listen to them. Enough is enough. Only those who are more successful than me, I will listen to them.”

As per the latest buzz, In the last few days, Kangana reignited her long-running feud with Taapsee Pannu after the latter commented on her upbringing. In now-deleted Instagram Stories, Kangana called Taapsee a “sasti copy” and accused her of “ridiculing” her upbringing and parents.

In further updates, She also criticized Baba Ramdev for questioning her character. Sonu Sood had called her ‘Generation Gutter’ remark “very shameful”, saying young people should be spoken about with respect. Rakhi Sawant also criticized her for saying India got independence in 2014.

On top of that, Kanagan had grabbed headlines a few weeks ago for her comments on the Gen Z and the student protests that took place at Jantar Mantar. She labeled certain young protesters and women as " Generation Gutter ," accusing them of adopting westernized mindsets. Later, Kangana pivoted to praise the Gen Z as India's biggest strength and ambassadors of the country's culture and identity.

title: Hansal Mehta-backed Birds in the Dark to premiere at Busan International Film Festival 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Set in rural Punjab, Birds In The Dark is a narrative Punjabi movie shot in black and white and also featuring dialects of Punjabi, Kashmiri and Urdu. Produced by Reema Kaur for Two Black Squares, and by Hansal Mehta and Sahil Saigal for True Story Films, this intersectional movie takes you through various thematics across gender, caste, and class.

Adding to this, In line with Busan International Movie Festival (BIFF)’s Vision section, Birds In The Dark (Hanere De Panchi) celebrates the independent spirit of Asian cinema, putting a spotlight on bold and personal storytelling of South Asian filmography.

Meanwhile, On the movie’s official selection, Director-Writer-Cinematographer Shashank Walia says, “ Birds in the Dark emerges from the people and returns to them. This movie was born from a desire to understand one another through mutual aid, care, and solidarity. It is in these acts that we discover what connects us, what is worth fighting for, and, ultimately, what sustains us; love."

Notably, Reema Kaur, who also served as the editor for this black and white narrative fiction as well as the Producer, reveals, “This movie is our sincere attempt to portray the quiet, mundane rhythms of everyday life, and the resilience that lives within them. Living alongside the community, listening to their stories, and working with them to bring this story forth, we discovered the power of the collective. It has been a deeply humbling journey.

As per the latest buzz, ”This is my 3rd movie at Busan ( Aligarh and Omerta as Director), and I couldn’t be prouder making my debut as a producer at Busan with Shashank’s exquisitely meditative painting on gender, labour, justice and love,” states Producer Hansal Mehta.

In further updates, "True Story Films has always looked to back distinct, director-driven voices alongside our mainstream work. Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi) belongs on a stage like Busan, and we're proud to bring it there,” adds Producer Sahil Saigal.

On top of that, Founded in 1996, the Busan International Movie Festival is Korea's first movie festival and one of Asia's most significant platforms for new cinema, serving as a cultural bridge between Asian filmmaking and the world.

title: Govinda warns of Rs 100 crores legal action over false marriage and divorce reports; flags deepfakes and AI content
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The development comes after a series of reports and social media claims surrounding Govinda’s personal life. Following the appearance of his wife Sunita Ahuja at court, reports had surfaced claiming that she had withdrawn her alleged divorce case against the star. Subsequently, rumours emerged alleging that Govinda had secretly married star Rani Swarnkar in a court ceremony. Such claims have as per reports been described as untrue.

Adding to this, According to the public notice issued on Govinda’s behalf, the star has cautioned the public, media organisations, digital platforms and content creators against creating, publishing, uploading, circulating or sharing any false, defamatory, malicious, fabricated or unverified material concerning him or his family.

Meanwhile, The notice also specifically addresses digitally manipulated content. It as per reports includes photographs, videos, audio recordings, morphed images, deepfakes and AI-generated material. According to the notice, no permission has been granted to create, manipulate or use Govinda’s voice, photographs, identity or likeness, particularly in relation to his private or family life, through artificial intelligence or other digital technologies.

Notably, The star has also cited his past experiences and expressed concerns over what he believes could be a deliberate campaign aimed at damaging his public image. The notice warns that legal proceedings could be initiated under applicable provisions relating to defamation, privacy violations, misuse of identity and cybercrime, including provisions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, and the Information Technology Act, 2000, along with other relevant laws.

As per the latest buzz, As part of the warning, Govinda has as per reports threatened civil claims of up to Rs 100 crores against individuals or entities allegedly responsible for creating or disseminating such content. The notice further states that he may pursue additional legal remedies before the courts, including measures concerning bank accounts, restrictions relating to property transactions and seizure of passports, subject to applicable law.

In further updates, The notice also calls for action against YouTube channels and social media accounts allegedly found to be deliberately publishing or circulating false and misleading information about the star and his family.

On top of that, The latest development comes amid continued public speculation surrounding Govinda’s personal life, with the star now signalling that he intends to take a legal route to address what he considers unauthorised and misleading reporting and digitally manipulated content.

title: Deepika Padukone not part of Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Brahmastra 2 ‘in any capacity’, actor's team clarifies
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Deepika Padukone is not attached to star in Brahmastra 2 , contrary to what the rumours are. The star's team has shared a statement to dismiss the speculation on her casting through her official spokesperson.

Adding to this, There were speculations that Deepika Padukone would be in the sequel. What did the statement say? The official spokesperson of Deepika states: “All recent reports of Deepika Padukone being a part of Brahmastra 2 or associated with the project in any capacity are untrue.”

Meanwhile, Brahmastra starred Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt. The movie marked the beginning of a big-budget fantasy adventure franchise. Brahmastra follows a Shiva (Ranbir), who sets out on a journey to find the origins of his special powers with Isha (Alia), a woman he falls in love with at first sight.

Notably, The movie, which collected over ₹ 400 crore rupees at the worldwide ticket-window, was one of the major commercial successes of the Hindi movie industry during the pandemic. In April 2023, Ayan had opened up that the two sequels of Brahmastra will be "bigger and more ambitious than Part One".

As per the latest buzz, In a chat with followers in 2023, Ranbir verified that Brahmastra 2 is very much in the development stage. He shared, “So Brahmastra 2 is heavy into writing. We are working on it all the time, it was just last week that Ayan narrated the movie to me. Ayan has gone ten times bigger than part 1, his idea, his thought, the characters. He is working on War 2 right now, so the plan is to finish War 2 by mid next year and we start shooting hopefully by end of next year, or beginning of next to next year. But definitely there's a lot of work which is already happening on the movie in the writing process. ”

In further updates, Ranbir also addressed the criticism that Part 1 received, and shared further, "We have really understood the kind of criticism we got for the movie. What worked for it and what didn't work for it. So we want to put everything into consideration. From the dialogues or people saying that Shiva and Isha's chemistry was somewhere missing... There was a lot of criticism that was constructive so we are taking that into our stride, and trying to understand that and kind of go beyond that."
On top of that, Deepika will be seen next in King, alongside Shah Rukh Khan. She also has Allu Arjun-starrer Raaka in the pipeline.

body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:
Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the young-adult romantic comedy stars Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati in lead roles.

Adding to this, The movie introduces four young actors—Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati—as they navigate friendship, young love, heartbreak, ambitions and the uncertainties that come with growing up. The cast also includes Kunaal Roy Kapur, Anurag Basu, Neha Dhupia and Anju Alva Naik in pivotal roles.

We can’t wait for audiences to immerse themselves in Shy’s world.”
Notably, A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

As per the latest buzz, Sharing their thoughts on the movie, Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt, co-founders of Eternal Sunshine Productions, shared in a joint statement, "Don't Be Shy has been extremely special to us from the very beginning, and we couldn’t be prouder to see it come to life. We can’t wait for audiences in India and around the world to meet Shy and get swept into her wonderful, chaotic world,”

In further updates, Don’t Be Shy will stream exclusively on Prime Video in Hindi with English subtitles. The movie will be available across India and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide from September 25, 2026.

title: 1942: A Love Story gets limited theatrical run after makers flag technical issues at certain cinemas
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a statement addressed to audiences and cinema lovers, Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films shared it had received a large number of messages from viewers praising the movie's theatrical experience over the weekend. The production house explained that the movie was restored in 8K resolution with Dolby 5.1 surround sound. However, it subsequently found that some cinema halls were not technically equipped to project the restoration in its intended quality.

Adding to this, The makers have therefore decided to limit the theatrical run to "handpicked theatres" that meet the required technical standards. The production house shared it does not want to compromise on the quality of the restoration and wants audiences to experience the movie "at its absolute best." Viewers have also been asked to check the updated cinema list to find the participating theatres in their city.

Meanwhile, The restoration of 1942: A Love Story was carried out over nearly two years in Bologna, Italy, and at Prasad Movie Labs. According to the production house, more than 150 people worked on the restoration, contributing over 9,000 human hours to the project. The iconic soundtrack alone as per reports required more than 300 hours of work from the restoration team to remaster it.

Notably, The filmmakers also noted that while India currently has 4K cinemas, the restoration has been created with future viewing in mind, allowing audiences to revisit the movie in high quality in the years to come.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, 1942: A Love Story stars Anil Kapoor, Manisha Koirala, Jackie Shroff and Anupam Kher in pivotal roles. The movie is produced by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, with music composed by R. D. Burman and lyrics written by Javed Akhtar.

title: SCOOP: Jio Studios backs out of Brahmastra 2; Ayan Mukerji begins hunt for a new studio partner for Ranbir Kapoor-Deepika Padukone-Alia Bhatt starrer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “Ayan Mukerji’s production house, Starlight Pictures Private Limited, was one of the producers of Brahmastra ’s first part and the banner holds the rights to the movie’s IP. Starlight will be producing Brahmastra 2 and they are looking at a studio partner to come on board.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “The makers were in discussions with Jio Studios to come on board as the studio partner for Brahmastra 2 . However, those talks did not materialise and Jio has now decided against associating with the sequel. Interestingly, Star Studios was one of the key partners on the first Brahmastra . With Star’s entertainment business now part of JioStar, and Jio Studios also operating under the larger ecosystem, there was an expectation that the association could continue with the franchise. However, as things stand, neither Jio Studios nor Star Studios is involved with Brahmastra 2 .”

Meanwhile, The source further revealed, “Dharma Productions, which also produced the first Brahmastra , is also not associated with the second instalment. After Dharma stepped away, Ayan Mukerji initiated discussions with Yash Raj Films (YRF). Aditya Chopra had shown interest in the project, particularly when Ayan was directing War 2 for YRF. However, following the disappointing performance of War 2 , YRF decided not to take the discussions forward. Jio Studios subsequently entered the picture, but that association too has not worked out. As a result, the makers are once again looking for the right studio partner for Brahmastra 2 .”

Notably, The search for a studio partner continues, though members of the trade believe that a project of this scale should not remain without one for long. An industry insider remarked, “ Brahmastra was a major theatrical success and the franchise continues to enjoy tremendous recall among audiences. More importantly, the second part is expected to feature Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone in leading roles, along with Alia Bhatt in an extended special appearance. That combination itself makes Brahmastra 2 one of the most high-profile Hindi films in development. There will naturally be considerable interest around the movie, and if mounted on the right scale, it has all the ingredients for a huge opening. So, despite the recent developments, Ayan and his team should have no shortage of potential studio partners to speak with.”

title: Exclusive | Abhishek Banerjee steps down from casting company: To avoid conflict of interest; questions were raised…
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
After spending around a decade balancing acting with running Casting Bay, star Abhishek Banerjee has decided to retire. Only from the casting duties, that is.

Adding to this, Abhishek Banerjee In an Instagram post on Monday, the announcement made it clear. Talking to HT City, he says the decision was “difficult”. Abhishek and Anmol Ahuja had started the company together a decade back.

Meanwhile, “I think it was any which way very difficult for me to handle any kind of company work and administrative work because of my shooting schedules,” he says. Casting, he adds, is not something he believes can be done remotely, “I don't believe in doing casting without being in the casting rooms. So for me that was very important.”

Notably, View this post on Instagram Banerjee felt he was no longer able to give the company his best, which prompted him to part ways. It is a complete separation from Casting Bay, he confirms, “I thought if I am not able to give hundred percent in something, then what's the whole point of doing it? It's better to let the youngsters take over and let them do the job.”

As per the latest buzz, The decision also came with a concern: the conflict between his two professional identities. Banerjee says he felt it was important to draw a line between his work as an star and his work as a casting director. “Because I am an star and then a casting director. These questions have been raised since I became an star,” he says. While he points out that there were “hardly any projects” where his acting and casting duties coincided, he felt it was better to remove the ambiguity. “But still I felt that let's avoid the conflict of interest," he adds.

In further updates, Banerjee makes it clear that leaving Casting Bay does not mean abandoning casting altogether. “I'm not saying that I won't do anything in casting. Maybe in the future I'll be planning something, but not as a casting director for sure,” he says. Instead, he wants to help make the profession “a more organized platform, a more democratic platform” and remain available to the casting fraternity.

On top of that, Banerjee's acting career started with small roles but soon expanded to Go Goa Gone, Stree, Dream Girl and its sequel. On OTT too, he has been part of acclaimed projects including Mirzapur, Paatal Lok and The Family Man. Mirzapur The Movie will be his immediate next.

“I want to put more focus on other stuff, and offline. I want to write, I want to produce. So I want to focus there. Hence this was my next step. It's just like sometimes you have to move on from some place to reach somewhere else," Abhishek ends.

title: Mirzapur actor Anangsha Biswas recalls getting vulgar, disturbing messages after Season 1: 'I was shaken'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mirzapur star Anangsha Biswas , who plays the role of Zarina in the web series, will be returning as her character in the much-anticipated Mirzapur : The Movie. Anangsha plays a grey character in the franchise, who uses her sex appeal to get ahead in the ruthless political world of Mirzapur. While Anangsha portrayed her character convincingly, she of late opened up that the same role that collected her appreciation also brought unwanted attention, with the star facing lewd comments and inappropriate messages.

Adding to this, Anangsha Biswas spoke about playing Zarina in Mirzapur. Mirzapur star recalls getting vulgar emails In conversation with Hindi Rush, Anangsha shared that she was deeply disturbed after the rollout of Mirzapur Season 1 as she started receiving inappropriate emails, with several people approaching her in an inappropriate manner.

Meanwhile, She shared in Hindi, "After Season 1, I was very disturbed because it was all very new to me. There were comments, strange emails and people commenting on my social media, with the same kind of words being used everywhere. I was a little shaken. I thought my work was my Saraswati and I had done it with complete dedication, so why were people saying these things."

Notably, She shared that many people assumed she was like her character in real life as well, which resulted in her receiving deeply uncomfortable emails and messages. "People asked, 'How much would you charge for one night? Come with us to Mauritius for two days, for a weekend." she shared. She added that such messages had filled her inbox.

As per the latest buzz, The star emphasised that this mindset needs to change and that people should learn to separate an star from the characters they portray on screen, especially if they play a bold and grey character.

In further updates, While films being adapted into web series have become common, it is relatively rare for a successful web show to make its way to the big screen. Mirzapur: The Movie continues the story from Season 1 of the popular series and brings together some of the franchise's most beloved and iconic characters, including Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Bhaiya and Guddu Pandit.

On top of that, Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu and Rasika Dugal are all returning to reprise their respective roles. The character of Bablu Pandit, originally played by Vikrant Massey in the series, will be portrayed by Jitendra Kumar in the movie.

At the movie's trailer launch, Farhan Akhtar, co-producer of the web show and the movie, admitted that the movie had been made following strong demand from followers. He shared, “The show is a result of followers' love. They have supported the show from the time it was first rolled out. Amazon took it across the world. Wherever I used to go, people used to ask me, 'Ki Mirzapur kab aa rha hai?' When it was revealed, people used to ask me the rollout date, so it is really the followers that have demanded this movie. We are very happy and grateful to have put it together with the original cast and the amazing new cast.”

title: ‘How do they explain this?’: Dipke has another question on CJP Jantar Mantar protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Monday shared that he spoke to two alleged victims of pellet gun fire from the July 20 parliament march, asking the police and the government to explain their injuries.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared that Sahil told him that he had appeared for the Delhi Police exam in 2025, which he alleged was leaked. (HFILE PHOTO) Dipke claimed that both protesters were agitating peacefully during the CJP’s Jantar Mantar protest, when they were “hit by pellets fired by the police”.

Meanwhile, “Spoke to Sahil and Vikas, two victims of pellet-gun injuries from 20 July. The police and the govt deny brutality, but how do they explain this? Sahil and Vikas were protesting peacefully when they were hit by pellets fired by the police,” Dipke wrote on X.
Notably, Dipke shared that Sahil told him that he had appeared for the Delhi Police exam in 2025, which he alleged was leaked.

As per the latest buzz, “He is a political science student and used to work part-time to support his family of five, as his father has a disability. He says there are still pellets lodged in his eye, and he has lost vision in one eye. He is now unable to work and support his family. If this is not brutality, can the govt explain what is?” he further wrote.

In further updates, Police on Friday lodged a first information report (FIR) against unknown people on a complaint by Sahil, a Delhi University student with pellet injuries during the July 20 protests, after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accompanied the 19-year-old and sat in protest outside a police station for more than six hours.

On top of that, HT has earlier reported three other alleged cases of pellet-like injuries received by Sheikh Irshad Mansuri, a 25-year-old employee at a private firm; Sahil Lochab, a student aspiring to join the police force; and a 28-year-old reporter who did not wish to be named.
Prashant, a 25-year-old Bihar resident who spoke to Dipke, had earlier told HT that he thought he would lose his arm after allegedly suffering pellet injuries on July 20.

title: Delhi student protests: SC says no to separate probe into sexual assault charges
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court on Monday clarified that there was no need to initiate separate suo motu proceedings to examine allegations of sexual assault against women protesters during the July 20 student protests in the national capital, as the issue has been referred to and prioritised by a five-member committee headed by its former judge R Subhash Reddy.

Adding to this, The HPEC was constituted to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into competing allegations. (ANI) A bench, comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, shared that the high-powered enquiry committee (HPEC), constituted last week to conduct an independent inquiry into allegations of violence during the protests, had specifically been directed to examine complaints of targeted violence, harassment, molestation and secondary victimisation of women protesters on priority.
Meanwhile, The clarification came after senior advocate Shobha Gupta urged the bench to take suo motu cognisance of alleged sexual assault of women protesters during the protests held on July 20.

Notably, Gupta submitted that there were widely reported allegations of women being molested and sexually assaulted by police personnel and sought a separate mechanism for investigating the complaints.

As per the latest buzz, The bench pointed to its August 18 order constituting the HPEC and shared the issue had been specifically entrusted to the committee. The CJI shared that the committee had been asked to examine the allegations on a priority basis and submit an interim report at the earliest.
In further updates, The bench pointed out that the committee chairperson had been empowered to appoint nodal officers, following which the procedure for submitting complaints would be notified.

On top of that, The HPEC was constituted to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into competing allegations arising from the July 20 student protest—petitions alleging excessive force by police as well as pleas concerning violence against police personnel and legality of the protest.

Other members of the committee include Justice (retired) Ravi Shankar Jha, former chief justice of the Punjab and Haryana high court, Justice (retired) Shalinder Kaur, former Delhi high court judge, Rishi Kumar Shukla, former Central Bureau of Investigation director, and LR Bishnoi, retired director general of police, Meghalaya.

Meanwhile, With Ajay Devgn reprising one of his most recognised roles as Vijay Salgaonkar, the movie is positioned as the concluding chapter of the franchise. The announcement has also set the stage for the return of the character whose story has remained central to the Drishyam series.

title: UDF announces one-day hunger strike over Centre's railway bifurcation move in Kerala
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

United Democratic Front (UDF) MPs from Kerala have revealed a day-long hunger strike on August 26 (Thiruvonam day) in front of the Palakkad divisional railway headquarters to protest the Railways’ move to bifurcate Mangaluru railway station from Palakkad division and merge it with Mysuru division of South Western Railway.

Adding to this, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan shared people in his constituency would be the worst affected by the decision. (ANI) The Railway Board’s decision has triggered protests in Kerala, with a section of leaders and activists alleging that it will lead to revenue loss for the division and hinder future innovation and development projects.
Meanwhile, Mangaluru Junction, from where several prominent trains to Kerala originate and terminate, is near the Kerala-Karnataka border and is a key railway hub in the region.
Notably, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan shared people in his constituency would be the worst affected by the decision.

As per the latest buzz, “We cannot accept this decision. We have sent an email to the Railway authorities in Delhi asking to reverse the decision. The hunger strike will be the first stage of the protest. If there is no result, we will stage a protest march in Delhi,” shared Unnithan.
In further updates, The Congress MP claimed that even the Union railway minister was unaware of the move.
On top of that, “Who issued this order without the knowledge of the Railway Minister and the officials of the Southern Railway in Chennai ?” he asked.
He shared the Palakkad division relies heavily on freight movement through Mangaluru port. “We are going to lose around ₹ 600 crore rupees through this,” he shared.

title: CINTAA head Poonam Dhillon responds to Upasana Singh's allegations: 'Every penny raised is fully accounted for'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Cine and TV Artistes Association ( CINTAA ) General Secretary Upasana Singh accused CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure of "dictatorship" amid allegations of prolonged tensions over the functioning of the association. Now, Poonam has responded to Upasana's allegations at a recent press conference.

Adding to this, Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure. 'Every penny raised is fully accounted for' As per a report in Deccan Chronicle, Poonam Dhillon defended her stance and addressed the allegations of financial irregularities. She shared, ”Upasana Singh’s allegations are completely baseless and false. Every penny raised is fully accounted for and reaches its rightful beneficiary. Not a single rupee is used for personal gain. We have zero tolerance for anything illegal or unconstitutional. Our work stands on transparency, accountability and facts and the records speak for themselves”

Meanwhile, Padmini Kolhapure also dismissed Upasana's allegations as untrue and shared, ”The allegations made by Upasana Singh are entirely untrue and without basis. The funds we raise are handled with utmost responsibility and are directed to the people and causes they are meant for. They are never diverted for our personal use. We have always maintained a strict stand against anything unlawful or unconstitutional. Our only priority is to ensure that the purpose behind every contribution is honoured with complete integrity.”

Notably, Earlier this month, 11 members of the 21-member Executive Committee resigned from CINTAA and called for fresh elections. The resignations were submitted to Upasana, and she accepted them in her capacity as General Secretary.

As per the latest buzz, The members had alleged that decision-making had increasingly come into the hands of CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior VP Padmini Kolhapure, along with some other members of the Executive Committee. The members also alleged that Dhillon had taken several key decisions independently, including communicating with government officials through her personal ID and deciding on communications with industry bodies through the association's official ID.

In further updates, In conversation with Hindustan Times, Upasana had shared that one of the key disagreements had been over the manner in which disciplinary action was allegedly being taken against artistes. She claimed that those who were not "yes ma'am" were issued show-cause notices.

On top of that, She also shared that, according to CINTAA's constitution, the resignation of at least half of the committee leads to its dissolution and fresh elections. However, she claimed that Poonam and her associates had not resigned. “Our constitution says that if more than half of the people resign, or even 50% resign, then our committee breaks down and re-election is revealed. This is our constitution,” she shared.

Upasana also pointed out that the association held an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) despite the committee having already been dissolved, further adding to the ongoing dispute over the functioning of CINTAA.

title: Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal welcome twin baby girls, Vira and Mahi
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Anushka and Aditya first met on June 26, 2017, at an event organized by Anushka’s NGO, Beti.

Adding to this, The twins were born on August 23, 2026. The couple introduced their daughters as Vira Ranjan Seal and Mahi Ranjan Seal through an adorable announcement card featuring illustrations of two little girls. Aditya Seal also shared a heartfelt note on Instagram, expressing his happiness and gratitude as the family begins this new chapter. "My sunshines are here to brighten our lives. Our hearts are full of love and gratitude. Vira ♾️ Mahi #TeamGirl."

Meanwhile, The couple had revealed Anushka’s pregnancy earlier this year through a series of maternity photographs. In May 2026, Anushka spoke to HT City about sharing the news and explained why they had waited before making the announcement. She shared, “We are a little late in sharing the news as the baby is set to arrive in September. We wanted to give ourselves some time, hence the delay. Also, it has been an overwhelming moment for us to share the news with all. I was more nervous than ever, even announcing my wedding was easier than this, but now I am at peace and relaxed, as people’s response and the way our friends reacted is so emotional for us.”

Notably, Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal first met on June 26, 2017, at an event organized by Anushka’s NGO, Beti. Their friendship eventually developed into a relationship, and after dating for a few years, the couple got married in Mumbai in November 2021. Nearly five years into their marriage, they have now welcomed their twin daughters, Vira and Mahi.
